x: After biding his time for the first mile or so, Kassa seemed to change gear at the back of the course to surge clear of the talented young Blackheath runner Mark Steinle.
Blackheath's Mark Steinle was up and away by the end of the first circuit and seemed to float over the morass to come home half a minute clear.
